page_title: TUN 0-1 AUS | Tunisia v Australia 26/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Daniel Siebert has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' The ball is cleared after Awer Mabil (Australia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90+4' Ellyes Skhiri (Tunisia) sends a cross into the box, but Mathew Ryan comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+3' Ferjani Sassi (Tunisia) picks up a yellow card.
90+1' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Tunisia is cautioned for aggressive play.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
88' Wahbi Khazri (Tunisia) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Mathew Ryan is alert and denies him.
87' Naim Sliti (Tunisia) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
86' Taha Yassine Khenissi (Tunisia) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
85' Graham Arnold has decided to substitute Craig Goodwin and he is replaced by Awer Mabil (Australia).
85' Keanu Baccus (Australia) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Mathew Leckie.
83' No change in the score after an effort on goal by Montassar Talbi (Tunisia) from a rebound. Good save by the goalkeeper.
82' Tunisia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
82' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Youssef Msakni (Tunisia), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. Tunisia will take a corner kick.
81' Montassar Talbi (Tunisia) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Australia.
80' Aaron Mooy (Australia) sends a long ball forward to Mathew Leckie, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
79' Mathew Leckie (Australia) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
78' Mathew Leckie (Australia) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
75' Graham Arnold has decided to make a change. Milos Degenek (Australia) replaces Fran Karacic.
74' Aaron Mooy (Australia) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tunisia.
73' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Dylan Bronn walks off the pitch to be replaced by Wajdi Kechrida (Tunisia).
73' Jalel Kadri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Taha Yassine Khenissi (Tunisia) replacing Issam Jebali.
72' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Youssef Msakni (Tunisia) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Mathew Ryan easily catches the ball.

72' Youssef Msakni (Tunisia) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the left side of the goal. It's a great effort but an even better save from Mathew Ryan, who tips the ball around the post.
72' Jamie Maclaren (Australia) tries to find Mathew Leckie, but he puts too much power on the pass.
69' The linesman raises his flag. Ali Abdi (Tunisia) is adjudged offside.
68' Ajdin Hrustic (Australia) makes a rough challenge and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul.
67' Substitution. Aissa Laidouni did his best and is replaced by Wahbi Khazri (Tunisia).
66' That's unlucky! Youssef Msakni (Tunisia) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
64' What was Ali Abdi (Tunisia) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
64' Graham Arnold prepares a substitution. Riley McGree is replaced by Ajdin Hrustic (Australia).
64' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jamie Maclaren (Australia) for Mitchell Duke.
63' Riley McGree (Australia) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Daniel Siebert stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.

61' Good touch by Ferjani Sassi (Tunisia) as he receives a great pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, the effort misses the net and flies well wide to the right. The ball goes out of play and Australia will have a goal kick.
60' Ali Abdi (Tunisia) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
60' Ali Abdi (Tunisia) serves up a nice cross, but Mathew Ryan punches the ball away.
59' Daniel Siebert blows the whistle, Riley McGree (Australia) is penalised for a foul.
58' Naim Sliti (Tunisia) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
57' A crossfield pass from Fran Karacic (Australia) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is behind the touchline and Tunisia will take a throw-in.
56' A pass by Craig Goodwin (Australia) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Tunisia.
55' Dylan Bronn (Tunisia) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
54' Mathew Leckie (Australia) commits a rough challenge and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for an infringement.
54' Naim Sliti (Tunisia) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.

53' Riley McGree (Australia) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniel Siebert has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Tunisia are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
53' Issam Jebali (Tunisia) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
53' Naim Sliti (Tunisia) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
52' Naim Sliti (Tunisia) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Mathew Ryan.
51' Kye Rowles (Australia) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Tunisia will take a free kick.
51' Mathew Leckie (Australia) is penalised for holding. Daniel Siebert signals a set piece.
50' Craig Goodwin (Australia) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
49' Ali Abdi (Tunisia) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
48' Tunisia work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
48' Aissa Laidouni (Tunisia) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play. Tunisia will have a chance to score from a corner.
47' Issam Jebali (Tunisia) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
47' Tunisia take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

46' Issam Jebali (Tunisia) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. The referee points to the corner flag and Tunisia will take a corner.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Jalel Kadri gives a chance to Ferjani Sassi (Tunisia) and Mohamed Drager is off.
46' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+5' A quickly taken corner by Tunisia.

45+5' Mohamed Drager (Tunisia) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Tunisia.

45+3' CHANCE! Youssef Msakni (Tunisia) fires just wide of the right post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Issam Jebali. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Australia.
45+2' Mohamed Drager (Tunisia) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The ball is out of play. Tunisia will take a throw-in.
45+1' Craig Goodwin (Australia) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Mitchell Duke (Australia) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball. It will be a corner kick for Australia.
45' Fran Karacic (Australia) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.

44' Mitchell Duke (Australia) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header low into the middle of the goal, but Aymen Dahmen keeps it out.
44' Craig Goodwin (Australia) takes a direct free kick.

43' Ali Abdi (Tunisia) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. It's a free kick to Australia, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
41' The foul by Montassar Talbi (Tunisia) was seen by Daniel Siebert who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
41' The resulting set piece from Tunisia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

41' A pass lands at the feet of Mohamed Drager (Tunisia) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Good work from Tunisia as they win a corner.
40' Mathew Leckie (Australia) makes a slide tackle, but referee Daniel Siebert blows for a foul.
40' Mathew Leckie (Australia) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
40' Mohamed Drager (Tunisia) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
38' Mohamed Drager (Tunisia) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
38' Youssef Msakni (Tunisia) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked.
35' It looks like Mathew Leckie (Australia) saw red with that tackle. Daniel Siebert won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
34' Jackson Irvine (Australia) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
34' The referee awards a corner and Craig Goodwin (Australia) goes over to take it.
34' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Mathew Leckie (Australia). The ball is out of play and Australia manage to earn a corner.
33' Dylan Bronn (Tunisia) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
31' Montassar Talbi (Tunisia) was too forceful with his tackle and Daniel Siebert interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
31' Jackson Irvine (Australia) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
29' Issam Jebali (Tunisia) is penalised for a foul. Daniel Siebert had a clear view and blows his whistle.
28' Mitchell Duke (Australia) is able to continue to play.
28' Mitchell Duke (Australia) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
27' Riley McGree (Australia) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
26' Aissa Laidouni (Tunisia) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
25' Daniel Siebert blows for a foul after Issam Jebali (Tunisia) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
23' 0 - 1 Mitchell Duke (Australia) reacts well to a deflected cross from Craig Goodwin and places a close-range header beyond the keeper into the right of the goal. 0:1.

21' Mohamed Drager (Tunisia) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Australia.
20' Issam Jebali (Tunisia) sprays a pass out to Youssef Msakni, but he can't beat his man inside the box. The ball goes out of play and Australia will have a goal kick.
18' Mitchell Duke (Australia) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
18' Mitchell Duke (Australia) picks up an injury.
17' Naim Sliti (Tunisia) is caught offside!
14' Mathew Leckie (Australia) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
14' The referee blows his whistle as Aziz Behich (Australia) was too aggressive in his challenge.
13' Fran Karacic (Australia) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
12' Riley McGree (Australia) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
10' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle. Issam Jebali (Tunisia) commits a foul after dangerous play.
10' Mathew Leckie (Australia) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
9' Aaron Mooy (Australia) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
7' Riley McGree (Australia) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
6' Aaron Mooy (Australia) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
6' It seemed like Aaron Mooy (Australia) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
5' Mohamed Drager (Tunisia) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Australia in a dangerous position.
5' A cross from Craig Goodwin (Australia) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
4' Aziz Behich (Australia) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is out of play. Tunisia will have a throw-in.
3' Riley McGree (Australia) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. It's a throw-in for Australia.
1' Mohamed Drager (Tunisia) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Australia will take the kick-off.
Daniel Siebert will officiate today.
